dense_matrix: uv run python scripts/benchmark_mlx_matrix.py --models qwen35 --high-concurrency --output-dir local/resident-state/dense-matrix
acceptance: Reject every measured trial with new system swapouts; require three accepted trials and exact greedy hashes across both backends for a three-run throughput claim. Historical baseline medians are not a controlled speedup experiment.

qualification.dense_b32: 1 Resin / 3 mlx-lm swap-free trials; no current Resin median qualified
qualification.dense_b64: 0 Resin / 2 mlx-lm swap-free trials; not qualified
qualification.moe_b1: 3 swap-free pairs but unstable; later warmups thrashed; not qualified

review.scope: physical cohort identity, release/publication ordering, read barriers, rollback
